label: High fear premium
note: Early fear (day 4 of stress, VIX high 35.9): Fear has only just begun and the VIX is still near its high: historically the first days of a panic are not the bottom (deepest follow-on drops); bottoms tend to come after fear has lasted and starts to fade. Variance risk premium higher than 98% of the last 10 years. VIX above VIX3M: the term structure is inverted, a sign of near-term stress.
method: Fear score = ½ × variance-risk-premium percentile over 10 years ÷ 10 + ½ × fear-phase score (calm 5, early fear 4.5, peak stress 6, fading fear 8, after fear 5.5). Bollerslev, Tauchen & Zhou (2009); Bollerslev, Marrone, Xu & Zhou (2014); Whaley (2009); Daniel & Moskowitz (2016); event study 2016–2026.
